description: This file contains implementation of certificate import and trust management functions for Mozilla's security libraries, including handling CA certificates, server certificates, and user certificates, with detailed trust setting logic.

methods.name: ImportCACerts
methods.description: Imports CA certificates into NSS database, handling trust settings and skipping non-CA or already existing certs.

methods.name: ImportServerCert
methods.description: Imports server certificates into NSS database and sets trust bits.

methods.name: ImportUserCert
methods.description: Imports a user certificate into NSS database, requiring a private key.

methods.name: SetCertTrust
methods.description: Sets trust bits for a given certificate based on its type (CA or server).
